findings.summary: Nine engagement emails retype the recipient list as literal 'To:/Cc:' text at the very top of the message body, directly beneath the .eml's own To/Cc headers, a templating artifact no genuine email carries.
findings.evidence: The rendered Middleton Email 1 shows headers 'To: Barbara Blair <...>  Cc: Kelly Snyder <...>, Heather Munoz <...>', then the body opens with the lines 'To: Barbara Blair' / 'Cc: Kelly Snyder, Heather Munoz' before 'Hello Barbara,'. Price-Henson Emails 1-4 duplicate the same way ('To: Tiffany Munoz' / 'Cc: Richard Henderson'). The Odonnell, Keith-Duarte, and Jackson threads have no such body block, so the same firm's mail is internally inconsistent and the affected messages read as machine-assembled.
